relations.description: Boundary Theory supplies the theoretical architecture within which Representational Mechanics studies and applies boundary, distinction-space, closure, and defect structures.
Distinction Space is the central formal object analyzed by the discipline.
Distinction Theory supplies the theory of distinguishability, representation, and contextual legibility.
Admissibility Theory supplies the theory of lawful transformation relative to invariants and closure conditions.
Emergence Theory explains how stable structure changes the next operative distinction space.
Mathematics tests whether the mechanics can be made exact through definitions, constructions, computations, and proofs.
Geometry and envelope families formalize spaces, dimensions, gauges, and boundary-defining structures.
Boundary-response and reconstruction mathematics directly formalize closure, transport, and recoverability.
Topology and homology provide machinery for boundary, persistence, obstruction, and defect classes.
Analysis and continuation formalize transport, singularity, branch structure, and failure of continuation.
Logic and proof theory formalize vocabularies, admissible inference, proof envelopes, and grammar conditions.
Physics tests whether the mechanics describe nature through dimensional validity, known-physics recovery, prediction, and observation.
Variational and Noether structures connect pressure, boundary terms, invariants, and defect-modified balance laws.
Classical fields provide explicit boundary, flux, transport, and reconstruction test domains.
Relativity and gravity connect reference frames, causal regions, horizons, invariants, and spacetime closure.
Quantum foundations provide a state-space and measurement domain for projection, admissibility, closure, and observability.
Thermodynamics connects pressure, capacity, coarse-graining, irreversible loss, and emergent closure.
Computational research applies the mechanics to learning, graphs, knowledge, memory, complexity, and agency.
Foundations of computation connect distinction, effective grammar, inspection, and closure machines.
Graph and knowledge systems make edge admissibility, path support, transport, and provenance explicit.
Machine learning provides test domains for representation, defect observables, calibration, and deployment admissibility.
Memory and agent architectures connect persistence, delegated action, bounded operation, and repair.
Computational epistemology studies the production, testing, transport, provenance, and repair of knowledge.
Boundary First operationalizes the discipline by beginning with the consequential boundary, invariant, defect, and repair path.
Boundary-First Engineering turns the mechanics into repeatable professional practice.
Software engineering provides a primary applied laboratory for representation, interfaces, lifecycle closure, defect, and repair.
AI as Forge applies explicit transformation and review grammars to research and artifact production.
Constructive Humanist Agentics supplies the normative doctrine for delegated agency, standing, responsibility, and repair.
Governance and institutions apply the mechanics to authority, consequence, standing, contestability, and repair.
Law and public trust formalize delegated authority, standing, liability, appeal, and institutional repair.
Finance and capital apply the mechanics to future agency, bounded obligation, externality, maintenance, and repair.
Infrastructure work connects lifecycle boundaries, maintenance ownership, defect visibility, and repair authority.
Systems criticism detects normalized representational defects and makes them publicly contestable.
Corpus and research operations preserve provenance, transformation rules, contradiction, promotion, and replacement history.
The Agent Pipeline project turns research transformation and criticism into a supervised operational grammar.
The Corpus Forge Workbench is a product concept implementing provenance-aware transformation, comparison, and repair.
The Agency Audit Platform operationalizes authorization, boundedness, legibility, contestability, attribution, and repair.
Software Before Code translates the discipline into a practitioner-facing account of representation, admissibility, boundaries, and closure.
Boundary-First Soccer provides a continuous, noisy, embodied on-ramp to pressure, boundary construction, admissible transitions, and repair.

notes: This is a presentation seed, not a claim that every relation has equal formal or evidentiary status.
Canonical top-level relationships are distinguished from supported local relations and exploratory mappings.
Facet order should remain stable after editorial approval to preserve spatial memory.
